messages:
Jamie (AE): FYI — Concordia (large healthcare analytics) is pushing for a bespoke price path. They want 30% off hosted + private deploy price-protect for 12 months. Also asking for POC carveout and dedicated onboarding window. Need deal-desk + security signoff.
Ana (Sales-Eng): Can you paste the proposed numbers and commit? I need to model infra impact.
Jamie (AE): Proposed term from AE side: 
```
Product: Redwood Private (VPC) + Hosted fallback
Commit: $200k ARR (12 mo)
Discount: 30% off list for year 1
Price-protect: 12 months from signature
POC: 6-week POC, no charge, converts to commit on success
SLA: 99.9%
```
Raj (SE): Technical note — private deploy + healthcare = HIPAA + HSM/KMS for keys, audit logs, and isolated network. POC will need a small on-prem sim or VPC peering. Is Concordia ok with our standard private onboarding timeline (4–6 weeks)?
Jamie (AE): They said timeline is flexible but want price protection while they complete SOC2 attestation.
Taylor (Finance): 30% is large — what's the margin at that commit? I need modeled gross margin and blended unit cost. Also need concession rationale for finance approval.
Ana (Sales-Eng): Quick calc — with current cost estimates, 30% at $200k puts gross margin ~38% (rough). If we shorten price-protect to 6 months margin improves ~+4 pts.
Lina (Security): We need the completed security questionnaire and confirmation of data residency. Also confirm whether customer will bring their own KMS or we manage keys. No approval until SOC doc requested.
Jamie (AE): I'll push the security questionnaire today and ask about BYOK.
Oliver (Head of Sales): @Taylor @Ana options: (A) Approve 30% for $200k + 12mo protection with Legal + Security sign-offs and stricter rollback if usage < commit; (B) Approve 25% for $150k commit + 6mo price-protect — faster to greenlight. Which one is finance comfortable with? :thinking_face:
Taylor (Finance): Prefer B. 25% @ $150k keeps margin above threshold and reduces risk. If AE thinks $150k kills the deal, we can escalate. Need commit dates and payment terms in the MSA.
Raj (SE): From infra perspective B is fine. POC still needs HSM requirement clarified. If they require customer-managed HSM, implementation time may add 2–3 weeks.
Jamie (AE): I'll counter with option B first (25% / $150k / 6mo protect) and keep A as fallback. Will also request BYOK confirmation.
Lina (Security): Send the questionnaire answers to security@redwood.com and cc me. We also need legal terms for data processing addendum (DPA) and HIPAA BAAs drafted.
dealbot: Escalated to deal-desk queue #DD-7864 (priority: medium). Please attach the term sheet and security questionnaire to the ticket.
Oliver (Head of Sales): Please update the deal in SFDC with chosen option and tag me for final sign-off. If AE expects to close this week, loop Legal earlier.
Jamie (AE): Will do — updating SFDC now and pinging Concordia for BYOK and questionnaire. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
